title: Kronos Resident Qualification
objective: Qualify the repo-proven Kronos heartbeat/lifecycle/supervision stock against current OTHRYS V2 Work, Talos, Rhea, Trust Canal and operating-mode contracts before any House admission or LIFE execution.
laws: Kronos owns LIFE/time/lifecycle semantics only where current evidence proves them; legacy naming grants no authority.
Rhea may escalate vitality concerns to Kronos but cannot invoke LIFE actions.
Talos remains execution-verification authority; Kronos cannot self-verify lifecycle effects.
Trust Canal and current operating modes remain the authority boundary for consequential actions.
No old scheduler, daemon, subprocess bridge, UI, or global state store is transplanted by qualification.
Heartbeat evidence is not execution authority and lifecycle proposals are not lifecycle actions.
PandaOS contributes no Kronos backend authority.
